editorial.verdict: A beginner mechanical with six feet, a nonstick foot and a metal needle plate that handles denim hems if you slow down at the thick spots.
editorial.whoFor: New sewists and menders who want a forgiving drop-in bobbin machine with more stitches than the Singer and a free arm for cuffs.
editorial.skipIf: You sew layered canvas or heavy denim weekly and want adjustable presser foot pressure and a faster motor.
